questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1 take hard courses. The university is better than ucph so take benefit of that. 
2 remember to skip school and go explore mountains. 
3 get a local friend so you dont just socialize with expats.
